integrity: Standalone exact symbolic proof with supplementary executable rational and complex checks. No claim of independent review.
limitations: Only the four consecutive characters of Z/6Z, complex coefficients and the fourth moment. Stronger older finite-fourier norm results not excluded. The recent motivating paper full text was inaccessible. Independent mathematical verification has not been performed.
title: Sharp fourth-moment amplification and sixfold phase locking for four cyclic Fourier characters
